object.name: FollowMeSettings
object.description: Settings for the FollowMe flight mode, which keeps the object reported in @ref TrackingData centered in a fixed, forward looking camera by yawing and climbing/descending. The camera tilt does not matter because the object is kept in the image center.

field.name: CameraFOV
field.description: field of view of the tracking camera

field.name: YawPID
field.description: yaw rate command (deg/s) per degree of horizontal angle to the object

field.name: ElevationKp
field.description: climb rate command per degree of vertical angle to the object

field.name: AltitudeWindow
field.description: maximum altitude change relative to the altitude when entering the flight mode

field.name: TrackTimeout
field.description: the object counts as lost when no new tracking frame arrives within this time

field.name: LostTimeout
field.description: time after losing the object before LostAction is applied
